selection_rule: Fixed equal-weight ranks; no selection or tuning based on these results
hardware_scope: Use the per-split hardware and sample counts recorded in this configuration. Match device types within each comparison and retain the run manifest.
coarse_cue_scope: Score-cue variants alter CV and PF only; final candidate composite-score weights stay at the unablated dataset profile. candidate_scoring_settings.json records them. This isolation was fixed before those variant runs.
normal_predictor_scope: Use the same 100-query subset for each predictor. MoGe variants share preprocessing and pinned checkpoints. Metric3D uses official centered mean-color padding and focal-length-scaled metric depth with the released range clamp. The conversion uses neither GT depth nor GT pose.

map_completeness.ranking: visible projected area at sensor prior, not GT
map_completeness.fewer_than_three_eligible_buildings: do not remove a building; report these cases explicitly

synthetic_prior_noise.distribution: independent uniform translation components and Euler angle perturbations; roll/pitch clipped to +/-5 degrees
synthetic_prior_noise.search: explicitly expanded grid and PF search, as implemented in ablation runner
synthetic_prior_noise.native_prior_comparison: same 300 queries with native priors, native solver profile and matched per-split GPU model; not an unperturbed-GT point

pose_selection_ablation: Use saved candidates on full splits. Compare PF, max IoU, max edge, max composite and fixed rank. Do not tune a new selector.
reporting: Recompute all values using strict joint translation/rotation thresholds. Report failures and coverage; omit or clearly mark experiments that cannot be verified, never invent numbers.
